BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I am down bad. I really need extra cash to pay my bills and buy Christmas presents. I already work 2 jobs and don't have time for another one. Do you have any suggestions? ASSISTANT:

Have you considered taking on a side hustle? Side hustles are often flexible and can be done on your own time.
